title.suggested: Allen among the St. Louis crowd at the Sullivan-Kilrain fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that John L. Sullivan would run for Mayor of Boston, and recalled that Tom Allen was among the St. Louis party at the 1889 Sullivan-Kilrain fight at Richburg, Miss.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Friday, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, August 20, 1897, page 6.

facts.fact: Allen traveled with a St. Louis party to see the Sullivan-Kilrain championship fight at Richburg, Mississippi

notes: Current title says Allen supported Sullivan's mayoral run; the article says nothing of the kind. Allen is named once, as present at the 1889 fight.
